acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction proudly serves clients across the East Bay, including Berkeley, Oakland, Albany, and El Cerrito. We have extensive experience navigating the specific requirements and regulations of these local municipalities to ensure a smooth and compliant build-out process for your commercial space.
